proseInstruments.sourceLine: We have a senior secured revolving credit facility (the "Credit Agreement") that provides for revolving loans in an aggregate principal amount of up to $ 1.900 billion with a $ 200  million subfacility for standby letters of credit.

available.sourceLine: Our borrowing availability, which is calculated by reference to a borrowing base that is determined by specified percentages of eligible accounts receivable, eligible inventory and Medicaid supplemental payments, was $ 1.900  billion at June 30, 2026.

maturity.sourceLine: The 2025 Credit Agreement will terminate on the earlier of (1) November 4, 2030 (the "Scheduled Maturity Date") or (2)  45 business days prior to the maturity date of (a) any series of our senior notes due in 2028 or (b) any series of our senior secured notes due between 2027 and 2030, but solely to the extent that the principal amount of such series exceeds $ 2.500  billion (each, a "Springing Maturity Date"), unless (i) prior to each Springing Maturity Date, with respect to at least 80 % of the aggregate principal amount of the applicable series of notes, the maturity date is extended to a date no earlier than one year after the Scheduled Maturity Date or such amount is repaid, defeased, discharged or refinanced, or (ii) on each such Springing Maturity Date, the Excess Availability Condition (as defined in the 2025 Credit Agreement), determined on a pro forma basis, after giving effect to the full repayment of the applicable series of the notes, is satisfied.

facilitySize.sourceLine: We have a letter of credit facility (as amended to date, the "LC Facility") that provides for the issuance, from time to time, of standby and documentary letters of credit in an aggregate principal amount of up to $ 200  million.

lettersOfCredit.sourceLine: At June 30, 2026, we had $ 105 million of standby letters of credit outstanding under the LC Facility.

maturity.sourceLine: We amended the LC Facility in November 2025 (the "LC Facility Amendment") to, among other things, extend the scheduled maturity date from March 16, 2027 to November 4, 2030 and revise certain pricing terms under the LC Facility.

results.evidence: No material asset sales or divestitures disclosed in the current filing period. The company recorded net gains from sales, consolidation and deconsolidation of facilities totaling $34 million during the six months ended June 30, 2026, primarily from consolidation of an ASC and sale of certain facilities, but these are routine operational activities, not major divestitures.

Tenet operates a Global Business Center in the Philippines supporting administrative functions, but the company's revenue is primarily domestic U.S.-based. No material international expansion or rising foreign revenue disclosed in the filings.
No new subsidiary or legal entity formation disclosed in the current filing period. The company's subsidiary structure remains consistent with prior periods.
No IPO or secondary equity offering announced or completed by Tenet Healthcare during the filing period.

Tenet's debt structure consists primarily of fixed-rate senior notes and senior secured notes. The revolving credit facility provides for floating-rate borrowings based on SOFR or base rate plus margin, but the facility had no outstanding borrowings at June 30, 2026, indicating minimal floating-rate debt exposure.

No material disclosure of commodity or input-cost exposure in the risk factors or MD&A sections of the filings provided. Healthcare provider operations have general exposure to supply costs and labor inflation, but no specific commodity hedging or material commodity price exposure is disclosed.

Tenet's operations are primarily domestic U.S.-based with a Global Business Center in the Philippines for administrative support. No material foreign-currency exposure or hedging activities disclosed in the quantitative and qualitative market risk disclosures.
